{{Top|leg}}
'''Biomolecules''' were organic manufacturing components. They were unable to be synthesized, and had a variety of uses, including military applications, partially organic industrial processes, and synthesized medicines. Biomolecules were produced by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] exotic plants native to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[New Cov/Legends|New Cov]].
